name: digiquiz-dev
description: DigiQuiz — run the real 3-tier app on one machine, reachable from a phone on the same WiFi.

scripts.syntax-check: node --check app-tier/app-server.js && node --check app-tier/db.js && node --check web-tier/web-server.js && node --check tools/qr.js && node --check tools/dev.js
scripts.reset-db: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('data',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('deleted data/ — the next npm run dev will re-seed from sql/digiquiz.sqlite.sql')"

comments.engines: Node 22.5.0 is the floor because Path B uses node:sqlite, which first shipped in 22.5.0. Node 18-22.4 can still run Path A (Docker), where the database is real MySQL in a container. If you are on an older Node and cannot upgrade, `npm install better-sqlite3` also works, but it compiles native code and needs a C++ toolchain.
comments.install: `npm install` here pulls three PURE-JAVASCRIPT packages. No node-gyp, no Python, no Visual Studio Build Tools. It is the only install step Path B needs.
comments.no-mysql2: mysql2 is intentionally absent from this manifest — Path B never talks to MySQL. Path A installs it inside the app-tier container from app-tier/package.json.
comments.no-dev-dependencies: There are none. The QR encoder, the LAN-IP detector, the process supervisor and the verification harness are all vendored in tools/ with zero dependencies, so this bundle works offline.
